cards.target: Comincia a fare freddo.
cards.english: It's starting to get cold.

cards.target: Come si prepara il tiramisù?
cards.english: How do you make tiramisu?

cards.target: In primo luogo, vorrei presentarmi brevemente.
cards.english: First of all, I'd like to briefly introduce myself.

cards.target: Le decisioni vengono prese durante le riunioni.
cards.english: Decisions are made during meetings.

cards.target: Scrivile un messaggio per il suo compleanno.
cards.english: Write her a message for her birthday.

cards.target: Alla fine, abbiamo trovato la soluzione giusta.
cards.english: In the end, we found the right solution.

cards.target: In ogni caso, dobbiamo trovare una soluzione.
cards.english: In any case, we need to find a solution.

cards.target: Nel contempo, dobbiamo anche pensare al futuro.
cards.english: At the same time, we also need to think about the future.

cards.target: Non mi pare che il ristorante sia aperto oggi.
cards.english: I don't think the restaurant is open today.

cards.target: Non credo che mia sorella sappia ancora la notizia.
cards.english: I don't believe my sister knows the news yet.

cards.target: Bisogna che tu faccia attenzione a ogni piccolo dettaglio.
cards.english: You need to pay attention to every small detail.

cards.target: La riunione sta per cominciare; prendete posto per favore.
cards.english: The meeting is about to start – please take your seats.

cards.target: Finiranno per capire che avevi ragione tu fin dall'inizio.
cards.english: They'll end up understanding that you were right from the start.

cards.target: Quando arrivo alla stazione, il treno era già partito.
cards.english: When I arrived at the station, the train had already left.

cards.target: Poiché l'esame è tra due giorni, devo studiare stasera.
cards.english: Since the exam is in two days, I have to study tonight.

cards.target: Stava per piovere quando siamo finalmente rientrati in hotel.
cards.english: It was about to rain when we finally got back to the hotel.

cards.target: Pur essendo stanco, ha continuato a lavorare fino a tardi.
cards.english: Despite being tired, he kept working until late.

cards.target: Per quanto ci provi, non riesco a dimenticare quella vacanza.
cards.english: No matter how hard I try, I can't forget that vacation.

cards.target: Il latte va conservato in frigorifero dopo l'apertura della bottiglia.
cards.english: The milk must be stored in the fridge after opening the bottle.

cards.target: Inoltre, vorrei aggiungere un'ultima osservazione.
cards.english: Furthermore, I'd like to add one last observation.

cards.target: Si producono vini eccellenti in Toscana.
cards.english: Excellent wines are produced in Tuscany.

cards.target: Si respira un'aria diversa in montagna.
cards.english: The air is different in the mountains.

cards.target: La statua è stata scolpita da Michelangelo.
cards.english: The statue was sculpted by Michelangelo.

cards.target: La macchina è stata riparata dal meccanico.
cards.english: The car was repaired by the mechanic.

cards.target: Il progetto è stato approvato dal consiglio.
cards.english: The project was approved by the board.

cards.target: La Ferrari è considerata un simbolo dell'Italia.
cards.english: Ferrari is considered a symbol of Italy.

cards.target: Dunque, abbiamo deciso di rimandare la partenza.
cards.english: So, we've decided to postpone the departure.

cards.target: In particolare, mi interessa la cultura italiana.
cards.english: In particular, I'm interested in Italian culture.

cards.target: Piuttosto, parliamo di qualcosa di più interessante.
cards.english: Rather, let's talk about something more interesting.

cards.target: Perciò, ho deciso di cambiare completamente approccio.
cards.english: Therefore, I decided to completely change my approach.

cards.target: Spende soldi come se fossero acqua fresca.
cards.english: He spends money as if it were nothing.

cards.target: Dall'altro lato, non posso ignorare i fatti.
cards.english: On the other hand, I can't ignore the facts.

cards.target: Per concludere, vorrei fare un ultimo commento.
cards.english: To conclude, I'd like to make one last comment.

cards.target: La mozzarella viene fatta con latte di bufala.
cards.english: Mozzarella is made with buffalo milk.

cards.target: La legge viene applicata a tutti i cittadini.
cards.english: The law is applied to all citizens.

cards.target: Eppure, qualcosa mi dice che ha ragione lui.
cards.english: And yet, something tells me he's right.

cards.target: La pizza è fatta in Italia da secoli.
cards.english: Pizza has been made in Italy for centuries.

cards.target: Si dice che Roma sia la città eterna.
cards.english: It's said that Rome is the Eternal City.

cards.target: Si ritiene che la scoperta sia molto importante.
cards.english: It's believed that the discovery is very important.

cards.target: Visto che sei qui, aiutami con questi scatoloni.
cards.english: Since you're here, help me with these boxes.

cards.target: Questo report va consegnato al direttore entro venerdì.
cards.english: This report must be delivered to the director by Friday.

cards.target: Per quanto riguarda il lavoro, tutto procede bene.
cards.english: As far as work is concerned, everything is going well.

cards.target: Semmai, il problema è che non comunichiamo abbastanza.
cards.english: If anything, the problem is that we don't communicate enough.

cards.target: Ha smesso di piovere finalmente; possiamo uscire adesso.
cards.english: It finally stopped raining – we can go out now.

cards.target: Mi tratta come se fossi un bambino piccolo.
cards.english: He treats me as if I were a small child.

cards.target: Il contratto è stato firmato da entrambe le parti.
cards.english: The contract was signed by both parties.

cards.target: Pertanto, la scadenza per la consegna è stata posticipata.
cards.english: Therefore, the delivery deadline has been postponed.

cards.target: Questa chiesa è stata progettata da un architetto famoso.
cards.english: This church was designed by a famous architect.

cards.target: La frutta viene raccolta a mano in queste campagne.
cards.english: Fruit is picked by hand in these fields.

cards.target: Il David di Michelangelo è conservato nella Galleria dell'Accademia.
cards.english: Michelangelo's David is kept in the Accademia Gallery.

cards.target: Nonostante la pioggia, la festa è stata un successo.
cards.english: Despite the rain, the party was a success.

cards.target: Per quanto ne sappia, la riunione è stata cancellata.
cards.english: As far as I know, the meeting was canceled.

cards.target: Il modulo va compilato in tutte le sue parti.
cards.english: The form must be filled out in all its parts.

cards.target: A dire il vero, non ero molto entusiasta all'inizio.
cards.english: To tell the truth, I wasn't very enthusiastic at first.

cards.target: Per quanto mi riguardi, la questione è chiusa ormai.
cards.english: As far as I'm concerned, the matter is closed now.

cards.target: Il Made in Italy è rispettato per la sua qualità.
cards.english: Made in Italy is respected for its quality.

cards.target: Non sono riuscita a contattare il servizio clienti per telefono.
cards.english: I couldn't manage to contact customer service by phone.

cards.target: In Italia si producono più di quattrocento tipi di formaggio.
cards.english: In Italy, more than four hundred types of cheese are produced.

cards.target: Dato che hai la macchina, puoi accompagnare anche gli altri.
cards.english: Since you have the car, you can drive the others too.

cards.target: Per quanto ne sappiamo, il volo non è stato cancellato.
cards.english: As far as we know, the flight has not been cancelled.

existing_tips: Subjunctive in relative clauses when the antecedent is indefinite or sought.
"Riuscire a" + infinitive means to manage/succeed in doing something.
"Andare" + past participle expresses obligation (must be done).
"Per quanto" (as far as / however much) triggers subjunctive.
"A meno che non" (unless) requires subjunctive; the "non" is pleonastic.
"Avere da" + infinitive expresses obligation or things to be done.
